name: @kalisio/krawler-rte
description: A Krawler based job to download generation data from the French electrical network operated by RTE.

scripts.build:generation: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --build-arg KRAWLER_TAG=${KRAWLER_TAG:-$(node -p "require('./package.json').krawler.version")} -t krawler-rte:generation-${TAG:-latest} -f dockerfile.generation ../..
scripts.build:units: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --build-arg KRAWLER_TAG=${KRAWLER_TAG:-$(node -p "require('./package.json').krawler.version")} -t krawler-rte:units-${TAG:-latest} -f dockerfile.units ../..
